messages:
Sana: short sync — need to finalize Q2 scope for audit telemetry + keystore/BYOK. customers want auditable exports and contractable SLAs.
Ethan: agree. let's define acceptance per milestone so sales can commit.
Sana: propose milestones: M1=hot-search (14d) + append-only writes; M2=export playbook + legal-hold flow; M3=BYOK handshake + rotation API.
Priya: quick prioritization heuristic: compliance_risk*0.6 + customer_commitment*0.3 + infra_effort*0.1. yields M1 > M2 > M3 for current pipeline.
Luke: infra note: M1 doable with index compaction work; M2 needs export pipeline and IAM mapping; M3 requires KMS integration and rotation testing.
LegalBot: legal: phased delivery ok if contract addendum lists feature milestones and emergency export SLA (48h). chain-of-custody must be immutable.
Ethan: acceptance for M1: p95 search <1.5s for 90% tenants, write immutability, tenant masking, export stub for 100k events <2m.
Sana: pricing thought: add "compliance" retention lanes (30d, 3yr, 7yr) with per-tenant surcharge and export credits.
Priya: ask: greenlight M1 for Q2 and run a BYOK pilot with one paying finserv customer in parallel?
Luke: +1 if we get budget for one infra contractor for indexer work.
Ethan: sales signal: if PO received we accelerate pilot.
Sana: next steps: Sana -> brief + SLA draft; Luke -> infra cost & hiring request; Priya -> pricing lanes; Ethan -> pilot outreach. infra-bot: created epic PROD-9001 (M1) and PROD-9002 (BYOK pilot).
